title: Switch 2 launch game price unchanged for both physical and digital versions
summary: Nintendo confirmed that Switch 2 launch games Mario Kart World ($79.99) and Donkey Kong Bananza ($69.99) will keep their originally announced prices for both physical and digital editions. The Switch 2 console price also remains $449.99 (unit) and $499.99 for the Mario Kart bundle, while accessory prices may be adjusted later.
content:
Nintendo announced on Friday via an update to its website that Switch 2 launch titles Mario Kart World and Donkey Kong Bananza will sell for the originally announced prices of $79.99 and $69.99, respectively, for both physical and digital editions.

The confirmation comes after the company previously delayed Switch 2 pre-orders, which had prompted speculation that Nintendo might raise console and game prices following the Trump administration's announced tariffs. Nintendo's update explicitly keeps the announced game prices intact despite that speculation.

Nintendo also confirmed that pre-orders for the U.S. will go live on April 24, and that the Switch 2 console prices are unchanged: $449.99 for the standalone unit and $499.99 for the Mario Kart World bundle.

The company cautioned, however, that some items could see price adjustments. "Nintendo Switch 2 accessories will experience price adjustments from those announced on April 2 due to changes in market conditions. Other adjustments to the price of any Nintendo product are also possible in the future depending on market conditions," the statement said. The company pointed readers to its website for more details on pricing.

Nintendo also reiterated the Switch 2 launch date remains June 5.

The statement appears intended to calm consumer concerns ahead of the pre-order window while leaving the door open for future adjustments to accessory and possibly other product pricing if market conditions change. Fans and potential buyers are invited to follow official channels for any further updates and details on regional availability and accessory pricing.
